label: Circular proposed experimental…: CircularProposal says every proposed experimental argument…
definition: CircularProposal says every proposed experimental argument depends on uniformity; it represents dependency, not proof entailment or a formal theory of justification. It cannot itself establish uniformity without an independent warrant.
note: Bounded analytical vocabulary for #269. This definition fixes test semantics; source endorsement or normative adequacy is not established by naming it.
